about: Jeffrey H. Lichtman, with over 35 years of experience in criminal defense, operates out of New York but takes on cases nationally, including in states such as Alabama, Florida, Maryland, California and Illinois. His legal practice is based out of the Law Offices of Jeffrey Lichtman and encompasses a broad range of charges, covering both white collar crimes like securities fraud and health care fraud, as well as nonwhite collar offenses including narcotics and Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act (RICO) violations. His client list is notable, featuring high-profile figures and cases that often attract media attention.

Mr. Lichtman earned his Juris Doctor from Duke University School of Law in 1990 after completing his undergraduate studies at Emory University in 1987. He established his own law firm in 1999, where he has since demonstrated considerable success. His notable clients include high-profile figures such as John A. Gotti and Joaquin “El Chapo” Guzman. His defense of Guzman during a three-and-a-half-month trial was particularly acclaimed, described by observers as both astonishing and wildly entertaining.

In the Gotti trial, Mr. Lichtman secured a dismissal of three murder conspiracy charges and an acquittal on a $25 million securities fraud charge, with the jury deadlocked on all other counts. His appellate successes are equally impressive, having secured the release of a client who was wrongfully convicted on multiple counts of sexual assault after a compelling appeal in New Jersey.

Mr. Lichtman’s skills in motion practice have also led to the pretrial dismissal of numerous cases, including a significant Medicaid fraud case. He holds an AV Preeminent* rating through Martindale-Hubbell and a perfect 10.0 Superb rating from Avvo, underscoring his recognition by peers and the judiciary.

An active member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the New York State Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, Mr. Lichtman is also a frequent lecturer and media commentator. His insights into criminal defense have made him a sought-after speaker and guest on networks like FOX News Network and Court TV Media. His career and legal acumen have been profiled in several prominent publications, including New York Magazine and The New York Times.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
